name: Clay Diorama
description: A soft clay miniature world on a round base, built in Three.js: chunky rounded shapes, warm studio light, a slow orbiting camera and a tilt-shift blur, with cream Fredoka cards explaining each beat. The diorama pops up piece by piece, then the camera orbits while the idea plays out on the little world.
best_use_cases: Science processes played out on a miniature world
How-it-works explainers with a physical model
style: Warm peach background (#f5d5c0), clay browns, soft greens, cream cards (#fffaf5), dark brown text (#5b3424) and one hot accent (#e2561e). Chunky rounded Three.js primitives with soft shadows, tilt-shift blur top and bottom, Fredoka cards with 44px corners, toy-like pop/wobble/splat motion, slow orbiting camera that pulls back for the takeaway. Bright pad bed with bloops, thuds and one big boom.
